description: Auditable memory for coding agents: evidence chains, supersession history, keyless embedded SQLite
name: io.github.yul761/statecore-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Override the memory scope name (defaults to the git repository root, else the working directory)
environmentVariables.name: STATECORE_SCOPE

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' together with MODEL_* variables to enable background distillation of conversational events; everything else works without it
environmentVariables.name: FEATURE_LLM

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible API key for background distillation (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Ollama, ...); not required for core memory, audit, and recall
environmentVariables.name: MODEL_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL for the distillation model (e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1)
environmentVariables.name: MODEL_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Model used for background distillation (e.g. deepseek-chat)
environmentVariables.name: MODEL_NAME
